fusions.name: Overhand Drive
fusions.desc: A two-handed thrust that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Pinning Slam
fusions.desc: Drives the butt of the haft into the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Weight Behind It
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Leaning In
fusions.desc: When you strike, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
